en.title: Minimum Replacements to Make Each String Pair Anagrams
en.description:
For each pair of strings, you may replace any characters so that the two strings have the same character counts; find the minimum number of replacements. If the lengths differ, it is impossible; output -1.

The standard input/output format and examples were compiled by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n; each pair then takes two lines, and an empty string is given as an empty line. 1≤n≤100, lowercase letters; each string has length 0..10000, and each pair has total length 1..10000.
en.output: Output n lines; line i is the minimum number for the i-th pair, or -1 if it is impossible.
en.explanation: The examples output, line by line, 0, 1, -1; -1; and 2 respectively.
hints: When the lengths are equal, count how many of each character the first string has in excess of the second, and sum them.
